questions.q: I have ___ finished my homework. Now I can watch TV.
questions.explain: 肯定句中表示「已經完成」用 already（置於 have/has 與過去分詞之間）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: I have ___ finished my homework. Now I can watch TV.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5A–5B Overview: Present Perfect Tense (already/just/yet/ever/for/since)

questions.q: Has your sister tidied her bookshelf ___? No, not yet.
questions.explain: 現在完成時疑問句尾詢問「……了沒有？」用 yet。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Has your sister tidied her bookshelf ___? No, not yet.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5A–5B Overview: Present Perfect Tense (already/just/yet/ever/for/since)

questions.q: Have you ___ ridden a camel? No, I have never ridden one.
questions.explain: 詢問「曾經有過某經驗嗎？」用 Have you ever + 過去分詞。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Have you ___ ridden a camel? No, I have never ridden one.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5A–5B Overview: Present Perfect Tense (already/just/yet/ever/for/since)

questions.q: Uncle Ben has lived in Sha Tin ___ ten years.
questions.explain: ten years 是一段時間長度（duration），現在完成時配介詞 for。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Uncle Ben has lived in Sha Tin ___ ten years.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5A–5B Overview: Present Perfect Tense (already/just/yet/ever/for/since)

questions.q: Aunt Judy has been a nurse ___ 2018.
questions.explain: 2018 是過去的起始時間點（point in time），現在完成時配介詞 since。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Aunt Judy has been a nurse ___ 2018.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5A–5B Overview: Present Perfect Tense (already/just/yet/ever/for/since)

questions.q: Fill in the past participle: Have you ever ___ (see) a panda in real life?
questions.explain: see 的過去分詞（past participle）是 seen（see - saw - seen）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the past participle: Have you ever ___ (see) a panda in real life?
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5A–5B Overview: Present Perfect Tense (already/just/yet/ever/for/since)

questions.q: We use 'How long' with the present perfect tense to ask about the duration of an action (e.g. How long have you studied English?).
questions.explain: How long 用於詢問動作持續了多久。
questions.subject: eng
